theorem: D(lambda) = E_lambda(1,0) - E_lambda(0,0) has a unique zero lambda_cross in I_5 = [1717/500, 1718/500]. The zero is simple (D' < 0 on all of I_5), so the boundary Maxwell transition is transversal: at lambda_cross the equatorial boundary value and the center value coincide, and their order swaps as lambda crosses it.

bracket.note: Widened from [3.43486,3.43488]: there the endpoint margin |D'|*dist ~ 6e-7 was below the achievable enclosure radius ~5e-6, so that bracket was not certifiable at any runtime. Here the margins are ~6e-5 and ~8e-5 against radius 7.6e-6.

method.boundary_value: 2D adaptive validated integral in half-angle regularized coordinates
method.tolerance_policy: tolerance matched to the bracket margin, not to working precision; the packaged default 1e-22 is 15 orders below the margin and causes the adaptive integrator to exhaust its depth/eval budget without finishing
